subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Inventory Turnover
description: A short lesson to help you apply Inventory Turnover.

hook.text: A store sells and replaces its stock 12 times a year. Its competitor does it twice. Who is healthier?

buildup.text: Inventory turnover measures how many times stock is sold and replaced in a given period.

discovery.text: Higher turnover means less cash tied up in inventory and fresher products on shelves.

twist.text: Too-high turnover can signal understocking. If shelves empty out, you lose sales you'll never recover.

climax.text: Amazon turns inventory roughly 8–10 times per year. A luxury jeweler may turn it only once.

punchline.text: Sell it fast. Replace it fast. Don't let stock sit.

quiz.question: What does high inventory turnover indicate?
options: Stock is sold and replaced quickly
